rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Item dated 12 September 2007, 15:00, Moscow: at a meeting in the Kremlin Mikhail Fradkov asked the President for resignation ('обратился к Президенту с просьбой об отставке').

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The item's headline states that Vladimir Putin accepted the resignation of the Government of Russia ('принял отставку Правительства России'), and its body that the head of state accepted the resignation ('принял отставку').

rows.role_title: Исполняющий обязанности Председателя Правительства — Acting Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The item states that the President proposed that Mikhail Fradkov perform the premier's duties until the State Duma approves the candidacy of a new Chairman of the Government.
